title: St Mary’s Christmas Tree Festival
venue: Parish Church of St Mary the Virgin, Rye
summary: An indoor forest of Christmas trees created by local businesses and societies, with a vote for the favourite tree and prize hampers.

title: HOS Annual Festive Lights & Family Event
summary: Join outside the New Inn in Sidley to switch on the Festive Lights, then head to Sidley Hub for family fun, free activities, and performances from the All Saints School Choir and Sussex Brass Band.

title: Richard Ayoade: Afterthoughts
venue: The De La Warr Pavilion, Bexhill
summary: BAFTA-winning actor and writer Richard Ayoade shares insights from his latest book, Afterthoughts, in an evening of reflections at the De La Warr Pavilion.

title: Rye Country Market
summary: A weekly market selling local produce including cakes, preserves, free range eggs, seasonal vegetables and fruit, unusual plants, and handmade crafts.

title: Brede Farmers’ Market
summary: A weekly market at Brede Village Hall offering fresh local produce, including award-winning lamb and fish, alongside hand-crafted goods and refreshments.

title: Triple Lock
summary: Triple Lock is playing live at The Queen's Head Inn in Rye on Friday 27 November.

title: Foraging Walk with Flavour Fred
summary: Join Flavour Fred for a walk to explore the local landscape and find wild flavours. The event includes lunch after the walk.

title: CROWLEY’S CURSE
summary: Crowley’s Curse return to The Chapel for a night of classic rock, featuring big guitar riffs and anthems. Entry is free, and you can have dinner and drinks before the live music starts.

title: Henry V by William Shakespeare
summary: A theatre production of Shakespeare's history play, following King Henry's invasion of France and the Battle of Agincourt. The performance takes place inside the Tudor Rooms with allocated seating.

title: Christmas at Bodiam Castle
summary: Enjoy a winter walk with hot chocolate, write to Father Christmas and take a photo in his sleigh. Explore decorated trees and a festive trail, or book a Christmas lunch at the Wharf tea-room.

title: Christmas at Bodiam Castle 2026
summary: The National Trust decorates the moated medieval castle with twinkling lights, Christmas trees in the tower rooms and Father Christmas's sleigh in the courtyard.

title: Christmas Shopping Weekend
venue: The De La Warr Pavilion, Bexhill
summary: Shop in-store and online for festive cards, wrapping paper, handmade crafts and gift vouchers. Members receive 20% off, while others get 10% off during the weekend.

title: Lost In Music
venue: The De La Warr Pavilion, Bexhill
summary: A high-energy disco tribute show featuring a live band and vocalists performing iconic hits from the 70s, including songs by Donna Summer and Chic.

title: Rye Craft Market
summary: A monthly craft market offering hand-made crafts, original artwork and prints from local crafters and artists, including pottery, jewellery and woodcrafts.

title: Charles Barnett comic singer songwriter
summary: Charles Barnett performs a full evening of live music, laughs and feel-good entertainment at The Chapel, featuring classic singalong favourites and original songs.

title: Henry V by William Shakespeare
summary: This theatre production follows King Henry through pivotal years of 1400s England, including the Battle of Agincourt. The performance takes place inside the Tudor Rooms with allocated seating.
